文献库中以下论文明确使用图神经网络（GNN）或图消息传递机制建模多站点空间关系：

- 论文ID 31（《MULTI-MODAL GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS FOR LOCALIZED OFF-GRID WEATHER FORECASTING》）构建了包含气象站与ERA5网格节点的异构图，采用消息传递神经网络（MPNN）进行端到端训练，并明确定义了站点间k近邻与站点–网格间近邻两类边，以显式建模多站点空间依赖；
- 论文ID 15（《Spatio-temporal wind speed forecasting using graph networks and novel Transformer architectures》）以14个离岸测风站为节点、基于经纬度差构建动态图，采用两层GNN作为主干，强调利用物理距离刻画站点间空间依赖以提升局地风速预测；
- 论文ID 21（《M2STAN: Multi-modal multi-task spatiotemporal attention network for multi-location ultra-short-term wind power multi-step predictions》）基于23个风电场地理坐标构建属性图，使用高斯核阈值距离函数生成边权重，并通过多头图注意力网络（GAT）建模非均匀空间依赖；
- 论文ID 13（《Time-frequency enhanced spatiotemporal graph network for wind speed forecasting》）构建时序加权图卷积网络（TWGCNet），将GCN用于建模站点间空间依赖，明确区分并协同处理“站点间空间依赖”与“节点级时序建模”。

论文ID 30（《Spatiotemporal wind speed forecasting using conditional local convolution and multidimensional meteorology features》）虽涉及空间建模，但其核心方法为“增强型条件局部卷积循环网络（CLCRN）”，未提及图结构、图神经网络或消息传递机制，因此不符合“使用图神经网络或图消息传递建模多站点空间关系”的要求。

**最相关的论文：**  
- 《MULTI-MODAL GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS FOR LOCALIZED OFF-GRID WEATHER FORECASTING》（来源编号：[1]、[6]）：明确构建异构图并采用消息传递神经网络（MPNN）建模MADIS气象站与ERA5网格节点间的多站点空间关系。  
- 《Spatio-temporal wind speed forecasting using graph networks and novel Transformer architectures》（来源编号：[2]、[7]）：以测站为节点、经纬度差为边特征构建动态图，采用两层GNN主干建模14个离岸站点间的空间依赖。  
- 《M2STAN: Multi-modal multi-task spatiotemporal attention network for multi-location ultra-short-term wind power multi-step predictions》（来源编号：[3]、[8]）：基于23个风电场地理坐标构建属性图，通过多头图注意力网络（GAT）建模非均匀空间依赖。  
- 《Time-frequency enhanced spatiotemporal graph network for wind speed forecasting》（来源编号：[5]）：提出TWGCNet模型，将GCN专门用于建模多站点空间依赖，与Temporal Transformer解耦以保留节点异质性。

sources.content: 该论文针对高原地区风速预测中“不规则球面采样”“动态局部依赖”“多源气象割裂”三大瓶颈，提出增强型条件局部卷积循环网络（CLCRN）模型。方法上，创新性地将球面几何（等距映射、夹角/距离加权）与气象物理（局部平滑性、全向影响）耦合，设计动态条件局部卷积（CLC）核，并构建多因子嵌入模块（MEM）统一融合气温、露点、气压、u/v风分量五维气象特征；实验基于NCDC公开的内蒙古25站2019–2021年数据（每3小时采样），在3–12小时多步预测任务中MAE/RMSE全面优于ARIMA、LSTM、STGCN、AGCRN等12种基线模型，平均MAE较次优模型降低6.2%；关键证据在于CLC权重可视化

Spatial dependencies can be important for improving meteorological forecasts, such as for wind. Considering the 14 measurement stations depicted in Fig. 1 used for this study, spatio-temporal forecasting aims to leverage spatial dependencies between different stations, through the physical distance between them, to improve the local forecasts for the different sites. The spatio-temporal interdependence of different physical locations can be particularly important for meteorological forecasts since physical properties such as wind fields, are non-stationary in both space and time, meaning that historical time series for different physical locations should be jointly considered to better learn global trends and propagation in both space and time. Some studies organise spatial data, i.e. the physical location of different3 Fig. 2. Visualisation of an RNN with LSTM units having forget, input and output gating mechanisms. measurement points, into an ordered grid, where the features for a particular location are assigned to a specific cell [42–44]. A CNN is then used to extract spatial features, while another network, such as a CNN [42] or LSTM [43], is used to learn temporal correlations. However, considering the complex topology of the different measurement stations in Fig. 1, the strict ordering of the input data required for CNNs might not be able to effectively represent the underlying spatial relationships. Graph neural networks (GNN) can better facilitate arbitrary spatial ordering and have therefore been popularly used for spatio-temporal forecasting. Khodayar et al. [45] made forecasts at different wind sites simultaneously, where each site was represented by a node in an undirected graph, using a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) and an LSTM to extract spatial and temporal features, respectively. sources.content: Multiple geographically concentrated wind farms can form a cluster, and the spatiotemporal correlations among these wind farms must be considered. This study employed GAT and Bi-GRU for spatial and temporal correlation modeling, respectively. The reasonable construction of a property graph is a prerequisite for realizing graph-based machine learning. 3.1. Attribute graph construction When using a graph neural network model for WPP, the input data comprises both dynamic and static data. The dynamic data includes the dynamic features of the wind farm at each location, whereas the static data includes the locations of the wind farms. The attribute graph G(V,E) can be constructed to capture the dynamic features of the WP in time and space, where V and E represent the nodes and edges of the attribute graph, respectively. A wind farm location is modeled as a graph node, and each node Vi has an associated static feature vector (size = 2) and a set of dynamic features in the form of a matrix. The former contains longitudes and latitudes, and the latter contains S types of historical features, namely historical WP and NWP data. Modeling the geographic proximity between different wind farms defines the edges of the location graph. The connections between nodes can be described by the weight of the edge. Because a wind farm is located in a specific area, the spatial dispersion is primarily based on distances. According to the Gaussian kernel threshold distance function of the wind farm, the weight of the edge between nodes i and j can be defined as shown in Eq. (3) [23], wi,j = ⎧ ⎨ ⎩ e− dist(i,j)2 std2 , dist(i, j)⩽ε 0, dist(i, j) > ε (3) where dist(i,j) is the geographic distance between wind farm i and wind farm j; std is the standard deviation of the distance between n wind farms; ε is the threshold. In this work, half of the average distance was selected as the threshold. If the distance was less than the threshold, it was estimated that the two wind farms are not connected in order to ensure the sparsity of the graph structure. 3.2. In addition, the Transformer architecture [14], with its self-attention mechanism capable of modeling global dependencies, has been increasingly applied to wind speed forecasting tasks. For example, Zhang et al. [15] proposed a CNN-Transformer hybrid model for multivariate prediction, achieving superior performance in shortterm vector wind speed forecasting. Chen et al. [16] developed methods integrating convolution and attention mechanisms, including Conv-SA and UNet-SA, significantly enhancing accuracy in high-resolution regional-scale forecasting. Considering the substantial impact of spatial dependencies on wind speed forecasting, modeling historical time series across multiple geographical locations provides an effective way to improve forecasting performance. To this end, conducting an in-depth analysis of multi-site spatial features to explicitly capture strong correlations and mitigate the interference of redundant nodes has been demonstrated as a crucial step for substantially enhancing predictive accuracy [17]. Given the intricate topological relationships among measurement stations, it is difficult for CNN-based representations to fully capture such complex spatial correlations. Therefore, graph neural networks (GNNs), which can flexibly model arbitrary spatial topologies, have been widely applied in spatiotemporal forecasting tasks. For instance, Khodayar et al. [18] combined Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) with LSTM to extract spatiotemporal features. Similarly, Stanczyk et al. [19] integrated GCN with CNN to capture temporal dependencies. Wang et al. [20] incorporated dynamic edge features into GCN for wind farm cluster power prediction. Wang et al. [21] developed hybrid architectures that integrate GAT with bidirectional GRU to model spatiotemporal correlations. Finally, Peng et al. [22] introduced GAT-based adaptive edge weight modeling to better characterize spatiotemporal dependencies and propagation pathways, achieving greater robustness under extreme wind fluctuation scenarios. 根据检索到的文献片段，以下论文明确使用了VMD、CEEMD或小波分解（Wavelet Transform，包括DWT）来处理非平稳预测信号：

- **VMD（变分模态分解）**：论文ID 38 和 ID 13 明确采用VMD（含优化版本OVMD和BVMD）对光伏功率或风速等非平稳时间序列进行自适应分解，以缓解非平稳性、抑制模态混叠；
- **CEEMD（互补集合经验模态分解）**：论文ID 17 明确使用CEEMD对风电功率序列进行分解，旨在解决非平稳性、模态混叠问题，并将其作为分解-集成框架的核心预处理步骤；
- **小波分解（Wavelet Transform，特指离散小波变换DWT）**：论文ID 18 和 ID 19 均明确采用DWT（离散小波变换）对风速信号进行多尺度分解，用于降噪、特征提取或提升子序列平稳性，直接服务于非平稳预测任务。

此外，片段[来源 7]（同属论文ID 18）进一步确认该文将小波变换（WT）与EMD、CEEMDAN、VMD等方法进行了对比实验，表明其明确将小波分解作为处理非平稳信号的关键技术之一；片段[来源 8]在论文ID 38中也系统比较了VMD与EMD/EEMD/CEEMDAN等方法的优劣，佐证其对VMD在非平稳信号处理中的针对性应用。

注意：虽然片段[来源 4]和[来源 10]提及综述论文ID 29讨论了分解方法（含VMD），但未明确说明该综述自身“使用”VMD/CEEMD/小波进行预测建模，而是评述他人工作；因此不计入“明确使用”的实证研究。同理，片段中未出现任何论文明确使用CEEMDAN或EEMD作为主方法（仅作为对比项），故不列入答案主体。

**最相关的论文：**  
- 《Short-Term PV Power Prediction Based on Optimized VMD and LSTM》（来源编号：[2], [3], [8]）：该文提出OVMD-IPSO-LSTM方法，通过FFT与互信息联合优化VMD参数（K=4, α=0.6），对光伏功率非平稳序列进行自适应单频分解，是VMD用于非平稳预测信号的典型实证研究。  
- 《A novel decomposition-ensemble learning framework for multi-step ahead wind energy forecasting》（来源编号：[3], [9]）：该文采用CEEMD将风电功率序列自适应分解为5个IMF分量和1个残差项，以抑制模态混叠并提升子序列平稳性，是CEEMD直接应用于非平稳能源预测信号的明确案例。  
- 《A Novel Hybrid Ensemble Wind Speed Forecasting Model Employing Wavelet Transform and Deep Learning》（来源编号：[1], [7]）：该文核心采用离散小波变换（DWT，dmey小波、10层分解）对风速非平稳信号进行多尺度分解，并与深度学习模型集成，是小波分解处理非平稳预测信号的代表性工作。  
- 《Time-frequency enhanced spatiotemporal graph network for wind speed forecasting》（来源编号：[6]）：该文提出BVMD（贝叶斯优化VMD）对多站点风速及气象变量进行自适应时频分解，显式嵌入周期先验以缓解非平稳性，属于VMD的优化变体在非平稳预测中的明确应用。  
- 《Multi-step wind speed prediction based on turbulence intensity and hybrid deep neural networks》（来源编号：[5], [11]）：该文基于离散小波变换（DWT）从实测风速中提取多尺度湍流强度（TI）指标，构成WSTI联合特征用于风速预测，是小波分解服务于非平稳信号建模的典型实例。

sources.sectionTitle: Methodology
sources.content: The proposed model comprises WT as signal decomposition technique, ABC and DE as optimization algorithms, and LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN, and CNN-BiLSTM as ensemble DL models. The ensemble DL model is defined as the model that utilizes the prediction of multiple models and combines them into a single prediction with assigned weights to each participating model. Furthermore, the weights are optimized through the DE optimization algorithm. The performance of the proposed models is essential for comparison with baseline models. For instance, the WT is compared with EMD, and CEEMDAN, and DL models are compared to their unoptimized counterparts. In addition, models based on EEMD, EWT, and VMD were compared. This section represents the background knowledge of various techniques, a framework of the proposed model, and performance metrics. 2.1. Wavelet transform The presence of noise in the time series signal significantly undermines the accuracy of the forecasting model, which highly relies on time series data. The signal denoising strategies are well known for removing noise from the signal. WT is a signal decomposition technique that converts the raw signal into low and high-frequency signals through low and high-pass filters. Discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and continuous wavelet transform (CWT) are two versions of WT. Equation 1 defines the mathematical expressions for the DWT, while Equation 2 represents the CWT applied to the given signal x(t). DWT (p, q) = 2 − ( p ) ∑L l=0 ψ∗ ( t − q ⋅ 2p 2p ) ⋅ x(t) (1) CWT (m,n) = 1̅ ̅̅̅ m √ ∫∞ − ∞ ψ∗ (t − n m ) ⋅ x(t)dt (2) where, L is the length of the given signal x(t), variables p and m are scaling parameters, and q and n are translational parameters for DWT and CWT, respectively. ψ(t) represents mother wavelet, l is the discrete-time parameter, and * denotes complex conjugate. CWT exhibits computational inefficiency and the requirement of large memory [41]. Thus, DWT is preferred over CWT for accurate signal decomposition. The present study has chosen DWT for decomposition, now called WT. sources.content: wind speed prediction decays dramatically with the increasing of prediction interval, since inherent uncertainty of wind speed significantly impact input and output relationship in regression models. The longer prediction interval to be considered, the higher level of uncertainty involved in training models. In order to alleviate the level of uncertainty in raw wind speed series, signal processing such as empirical mode decomposition/ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EMD/EEMD), variational mode decomposition (VMD), wavelet analysis were thrived to be new approaches implementing on wind speed series with the aim of decomposing original series into amount of subseries on different patterns or frequencies. Kiplangat [30] proved that simple auto-regression model can achieve ideal prediction result when apply time series decomposition. Sun et al. [31] adopted the EEMD to decompose wind speed series into several intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) as well as residual series. Liu [32] compared the wavelet packet decomposition and ensemble empirical mode decomposition on short-term wind prediction. Peng [35] applied two-stage decomposition strategies, which used EEMD as first decomposition and VMD on first decomposed series. Li [36] introduced VMD to decompose raw data and applied Gram–Schmidt orthogonal algorithm to select best fit features. Tascikaraoglu et al. [37] employed discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to extract stationary components for wind speed. Liu et al. [28] applied wavelet packet transform (WPT) to extract several subseries on different frequency resolutions and then predicted each subseries respectively. Motivated by the aforementioned limitations, this paper proposes a hybrid model for spatiotemporal wind speed forecasting. The model aims to address feature entanglement in graph-based methods and the limited adaptability of traditional decomposition techniques in multi-site scenarios. The proposed framework integrates a time-frequency feature refinement module with a spatiotemporal modeling network. Specifically, Bayesian-optimized Variational Mode Decomposition (BVMD) is employed to adaptively decompose multi-site wind speed series and meteorological variables, addressing the limited adaptability of conventional decomposition methods under heterogeneous spatial conditions. A Periodicity-Aware Mechanism (PAM) is further introduced to enhance multi-scale periodic feature representation, especially under noisy and non-stationary environments. Based on the refined features, a Temporal Transformer-augmented WeatherGCNet (TWGCNet) is constructed to jointly model spatial dependencies and node-level temporal dynamics. This design enables independent temporal modeling at each station while preserving spatial relationships, thereby mitigating the over-smoothing problem in graph-based aggregation. Overall, the proposed framework provides a unified solution for capturing inter-station relationships and temporal evolution patterns, offering an effective approach for accurate wind speed forecasting. results.answer:
根据检索到的文献片段，以下论文分别以ARMA或ARIMA为核心，并**明确结合了VAR、ESN或时空克里金（spatio-temporal kriging，即STOK）中的一种或多种**：

- **ARIMA + 时空克里金（STOK）**：来源1和来源5均指向同一篇论文（ID: 35），该文将ARIMA（具体为ARIMA(1,1,0)）用于时间趋势提取与残差生成，再基于平稳残差构建时空协方差结构，并采用**时空普通克里金（STOK）**进行联合插值预测。

- **ARMA + ESN（回声状态网络）**：来源2和来源6均指向论文ID: 34，该文采用AIC优选的**ARMA模型提取线性分量**，再用**ABC优化的ESN对非线性残差建模补偿**，构成ARMA-ESN混合框架。

- **ARMA + VAR**：来源3和来源7均指向论文ID: 33，该文系统比较了多种ARMA类方法，其中明确将**BIC优选的VAR(3)模型**列为四种“ARMA based approaches”之一（并指出其为受限VAR(3)的对比基线），且实验设计直接围绕风速–风向元组的联合预测展开，将VAR作为与ARMA同级的多变量时序建模范式进行实证评估；文中虽未称其为“ARMA+VAR混合模型”，但将其纳入“ARMA based approaches”范畴，并与分量ARMA、链接ARMA等并列分析，表明其研究语境中VAR是ARMA范式的自然延伸与对比对象，且核心任务（风速风向联合预测）依赖于ARMA思想下的多变量扩展——即VAR。因此，该文符合“以ARMA为核心并结合VAR”的广义理解（VAR是ARMA在多变量情形下的直接推广）。

综上，三篇论文分别覆盖了用户所问的三种组合：
- ARIMA + 时空克里金 → 论文ID: 35  
- ARMA + ESN → 论文ID: 34  
- ARMA + VAR → 论文ID: 33  

未发现同时结合其中两种及以上（如ARIMA+VAR+ESN）或涉及其他未提及技术的文献；也无文献将ARMA/ARIMA与VAR、ESN、时空克里金三者全部结合。

**最相关的论文：**  
- 《Wind Speed Prediction based on Spatio-Temporal Covariance Model Using Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Regression Smoothing》（来源编号：[1], [5]）：该文以ARIMA(1,1,0)为核心提取时间趋势，并将平稳残差输入时空普通克里金（STOK）进行时空联合预测，实现了ARIMA与时空克里金的深度耦合。  
- 《Short-term wind speed forecasting based on autoregressive moving average with echo state network compensation》（来源编号：[2], [6]）：该文以AIC优选的ARMA模型提取线性分量，再用人工蜂群优化的回声状态网络（ESN）对非线性残差建模补偿，构成典型的ARMA-ESN混合架构。  
- 《ARMA based approaches for forecasting the tuple of wind speed and direction》（来源编号：[3], [7]）：该文将VAR(3)作为“ARMA based approaches”之一进行系统实证比较，聚焦风速与风向二维元组联合预测，将VAR视为ARMA在多变量场景下的自然扩展与结合形式，并通过BIC准则选定阶数、与多种ARMA变体同台评估。

在检索到的文献片段中，唯一一篇明确属于光伏（PV）功率预测的论文是论文ID为38的《Short-Term PV Power Prediction Based on Optimized VMD and LSTM》。其余所有提及的论文（如ID 19）均聚焦于风速预测任务，属于风电领域。

该光伏功率预测论文与风速预测任务存在本质区别：  
- **预测对象不同**：前者预测的是光伏电站输出的**有功功率（kW/kWp）**，其核心驱动因子是太阳辐照度、温度等气象变量，且受云层遮挡、组件衰减、倾角/方位角等设备与几何因素影响；后者（如ID 19）预测的是**风速（m/s）**，直接关联风机动能输入，核心不确定性源于大气湍流结构与边界层动力学。  
- **物理机制差异显著**：光伏功率具有强非线性日周期性和骤变性（如云瞬态遮挡导致功率秒级跌落），而风速变化相对连续但含多尺度湍流扰动；因此ID 38采用VMD分解+LSTM建模短时非平稳功率波动，而ID 19则引入湍流强度（TI）作为物理约束特征，强调跨时间尺度的风速能量传递规律。  
- **任务目标与评价侧重不同**：ID 38明确面向“短期（<4小时）”功率预测，服务于电网AGC和储能调度；ID 19针对“中长期（4–12小时）”风速预测，并发现“预测间隔不得超过TI特征最高时间分辨率”这一物理约束规律，凸显其对预测时效边界的机理认知。

当前文献片段中未提及其他光伏功率预测论文，因此ID 38是唯一被检出的光伏功率预测论文。

**最相关的论文：**  
- 《Short-Term PV Power Prediction Based on Optimized VMD and LSTM》（来源编号：[2] 和 [4]）：这是检索结果中唯一明确以光伏（PV）功率为预测目标的论文，且详细描述了其方法设计与问题定义，与用户要求的“唯一光伏功率预测论文”完全匹配。

sources.sectionTitle: Introduction
sources.content: With the growing concerns on fossil energy shortage and environmental issues [1], wind power has been a major source of energy supplement all over the world [2]. Wind turbine is explicitly designed as power generator which converts wind kinetic energy to electric energy, thus the stability and capability of wind power utilization are highly related to wind speed. Due to the inherent nature of uncertainty and intermittency on wind speed, high penetration of wind power poses significant instability impact on power system, thus in turn causes curtailment on wind power [3]. Therefore, accurate wind speed prediction thrives to be a prevalent research topic over the last decade with the aim of reducing the effect of wind speed instability and improving reliability of wind power generation. Basically, wind speed prediction refers to predict a period time series of wind speed forth ahead by using historical wind speed data or expertise physical knowledge. Therefore, wind speed prediction mainly comprises two categories: data-driven model based prediction and physical model based prediction. With aspect to physical model based prediction, Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) and Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) are the most popular technics tackling middle term and long-term wind speed prediction in large scale of area and spatial resolution. sources.content: A. PROBLEM DEFINITION With the rapid development of science and technology, the energy demand becomes very important [1], [2]. Comparison with the other energy resources, the solar power is the one of most desired energy due to the advantages of cleanliness, good potential, extendibility and universality [3]. Many counties have developed the large scale photovoltaic (PV) plants to reduce the environmental pollution. However, the PV power system has the drawbacks of intermittence and fluctuation due to un-governable solar irradiance and the metrological factors, such as wind speed, temperature, humidity and dew-retting [4], [5]. However, the accuracy prediction of PV power can improve the reliability of power system and decrease the uncertainty of PV power on the power grid [6]. According to the difference of the predicted during time, the prediction of PV power can be divided into The associate editor coordinating the review of this manuscript and approving it for publication was Jonghoon Kim . long term prediction (during time >1 month), medium term prediction (during time 1∼7 days) and short term prediction (during time < 4 hours). Among the prediction mode, the short term prediction is very important for energy storage and load control. The short term prediction can make an important contribution for supervision and regulation of power market. B. STATE OF THE ART
